The term 'lady' implies grace, elegance, and refinement, while 'slave' signifies complete submission and devotion. Thus, a woman named Kaneez is seen as someone who embodies the ideals of submission to Allah and rhetoric of feminine beauty and grace.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kaneez is profound. It is a reminder that every human being is the servant of Allah, and our ultimate goal in life should be to serve Him. The two meanings of the name - 'lady' and 'slave' - symbolize the dual nature of our existence - we are created with dignity and beauty, but also with the innate desire to serve and worship Allah. Thus, the name Kaneez is not only a name of respect and devotion, but also a constant reminder of the ultimate purpose of our existence - to serve and worship Allah.
